design: Two predefined traffic geometries x two controlled wind bearings x two frozen hold-guidance modes; all eight arms retained.
fixture_selection: Both eligible definitions fixed before first new-encounter navigation output. No outcome-based retiming, geometry tuning or exclusion.
nominal_guidance: Gamma + Direct acados NMPC; unchanged forecast tacks, hold tacks, refined return and physical release guard.
runtime_traffic_input: Analytical JSON parameters only; independently exported truth CSV is not read by the navigation runtime.
timing_scope: Every complete AIS choose attempt, including lazy construction/search/dense checks and unsuccessful/exceptional final attempts, must be retained. Constructor time and fresh-process cold tests are reported separately.
outcome_scope: Full uncertainty and reserve clearance, <=50m capture sequence, and <5s decision budget are separate checks. Retained early stops, rejected controls and deadline failures are not censored.
baseline_reference: ../otranto_weak_wind_ais_fast_recovery; archival conditions/tack plans/checkpoint unchanged, new traffic/faults deliberately differ.
